name: harness-marketplace
description: harness — spec-driven development enforcement for autonomous coding agents. Skills guide the workflow, hooks bind the rules, a framework-agnostic engine decides.

plugins.name: harness
plugins.description: Development enforcement plugin: two-phase context injection (resolver + gates G1-G8), interface shadows via tree-sitter, ADR-compiled decision tables, slice-based build loop with worktree partitioning, four-layer review stack with golden replay, and adjudication that converts every human intervention into durable substrate. Includes /harness:init, architect, backlog, build, review, close-slice, status, adjudicate workflows plus 7 knowledge skills and 4 agent personas.
